Convert to a question set

Source: R/questions.R
as_laya_questions.Rd

Accepts a question set in the Python SDK's format, so question sets can be shared between Python and R: an R list, a JSON string, or the path to a .json file.

Usage

as_laya_questions(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A laya_questions object, a named list in the Python format (list(id = list(type = , instructions = , criteria = ))), a JSON string, or a path to a JSON file.

...

Unused.

Value

A laya_questions object.

Examples

as_laya_questions('{
  "urgency": {"type": "score", "instructions": "How urgent?",
              "criteria": ["low", "high"]}
}')
#> <laya_questions> 1 question
#>   urgency  score  How urgent?  [2 levels]
